briefdescription.para: addMachineSSAOptimization - Add standard passes that optimize machine instructions in SSA form.

detaileddescription.para: Add passes that optimize machine instructions in SSA form.

briefdescription.para: Add common target configurable passes that perform LLVM IR to IR transforms following machine independent optimization.
Add common passes that perform LLVM IR to IR transforms in preparation for instruction selection.
This method should install an IR translator pass, which converts from LLVM code to machine instructions with possibly generic opcodes.
This method may be implemented by targets that want to run passes immediately before legalization.
This method should install a legalize pass, which converts the instruction sequence into one that can be selected by the target.
This method should install a register bank selector pass, which assigns register banks to virtual registers without a register class or register banks.

This method should install a (global) instruction selector pass, which converts possibly generic instructions to fully target-specific instructions, thereby constraining all generic virtual registers to register classes.
createTargetRegisterAllocator - Create the register allocator pass for this target at the current optimization level.

detaileddescription.para: Instantiate the default register allocator pass for this target for either the optimized or unoptimized allocation path.
This will be added to the pass manager by addFastRegAlloc in the unoptimized case or addOptimizedRegAlloc in the optimized case.
A target that uses the standard regalloc pass order for fast or optimized allocation may still override this for per-target regalloc selection. But -regalloc=... always takes precedence.

briefdescription.para: addFastRegAlloc - Add the minimum set of target-independent passes that are required for fast register allocation.

detaileddescription.para: Add the minimum set of target-independent passes that are required for register allocation.

briefdescription.para: addOptimizedRegAlloc - Add passes related to register allocation.

detaileddescription.para: Add standard target-independent passes that are tightly coupled with optimized register allocation, including coalescing, machine instruction scheduling, and register allocation itself.
CodeGenTargetMachineImpl provides standard regalloc passes for most targets.

briefdescription.para: This method may be implemented by targets that want to run passes after register allocation pass pipeline but before prolog-epilog insertion.
This pass may be implemented by targets that want to run passes immediately before machine code is emitted.
